title: Close Receipt
description: Defines the formal closure record for an agent capsule. Every agent MUST produce a close receipt upon termination, regardless of close reason. No close receipt without verifier confirmation is accepted.

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent being closed.

phase.description: Factory phase this agent operated in.

role.description: The functional role the agent performed.

closeReason.description: Reason for agent closure. COMPLETED = work done, FAILED = unrecoverable error, STALE = timed out, REPLACED = swapped out.

outputSummary.description: Substantive summary of what the agent produced or why it failed. Must reference concrete artifacts.

evidencePaths.description: Paths to all evidence files supporting this receipt.

verifierConfirmation.description: MUST be true for COMPLETED receipts. Set by the verifier agent after confirming all evidence.

integrityCheckPassed.description: Whether SHA256 integrity checks passed on all output files. False = receipt is invalid.

replacementAgentId.description: If closeReason is REPLACED, the agentId of the replacement agent. Omitted otherwise.

spawnFailureClassified.description: If closeReason is FAILED due to spawn failure, the failure classification. Omitted otherwise.

nativeGenerated.description: MUST be true. Indicates this receipt was generated by the agent system.
